en.answer: Even if <<14465>> was Tribute Set, its effect that prevents your opponent from targeting it will be applied once it is flipped face-up.
en.question: I Tribute Set a <<14465>> in face-down Defense Position. After that, if <<14465>> is flipped face-up, will its effect that prevents my opponent from targeting it be applied?
